classification: executable certification substrate; not an end-to-end self-improvement system

immutable_candidate_identity.details: LearnedPolicyArtifact is frozen and binds scenario hash, complete finite-search configuration hash, selected parameters, train seed/repetitions, candidate count, parameter dimension, and exact visible feature contract into a canonical SHA-256 policy_hash. Tests reject malformed or tampered provenance before evaluation.

train_evaluation_separation.details: evaluate_learned_policy requires a frozen artifact, matching scenario identity/hash, and an evaluation seed distinct from the training seed; it evaluates fresh child streams and labels the result conditional held-out rather than an optimality theorem.

selection_confirmation_filtration.details: SelectionTrace records only visible filtration, rejects hidden-state exposure, hashes the canonical visible stream, and SplitConfirmationResult requires distinct selection/confirmation seeds with a separately hashed confirmation payload. Tests verify distinct stream hashes and visible-only selection.

cross_candidate_statistical_accounting.details: online_fdr.py implements LORD++, SAFFRON, and e-LOND traces. Serialized thresholds/rejections/accounting are re-derived from the supplied ordered evidence history and rejected if inconsistent. The implementation explicitly distinguishes procedural alpha wealth from e-LOND cumulative nominal level allocation.

scope_labels.details: The repository explicitly states that a per-target e-process crossing is not a family-level FWER/FDR guarantee, that held-out learned-policy evaluation is a conditional operating characteristic rather than policy optimality, and that richer split-confirmation settings may remain diagnostic rather than formal.

not_verified_or_missing.real_reversible_self_improvement_loop: The inspected project is an investigator-facing adaptive-study/simulation suite, not an AgentOpt-like persistent agent self-improvement loop.
not_verified_or_missing.candidate_local_anytime_promotion_gate: Time-uniform evidence components exist, but this audit did not establish an end-to-end candidate promotion transaction for a self-modifying agent.
not_verified_or_missing.restart_durable_statistical_ledger: The inspected online-FDR objects validate complete supplied histories but are not, in the inspected paths, a crash-durable append-only ledger with no-refund restart semantics.
not_verified_or_missing.provider_evaluator_write_ahead_reconcili: No provider-side exactly-once/write-ahead evaluation transaction was established in the inspected paths.
not_verified_or_missing.terminal_outer_namespace: Held-out evaluation uses fresh streams and a frozen artifact, but evaluate_learned_policy remains callable; this is not a structurally one-shot/cache-only terminal OUTER namespace.
not_verified_or_missing.complete_proposal_chronology: Not applicable as a self-improvement proposal lineage because the inspected learned-policy search is a finite declared candidate search.

design_implication: The public release provides a concrete executable substrate for three pieces that should sit underneath real self-improvement: content-bound candidate/search identity, explicit adaptive-selection versus independent-confirmation filtration, and family-level statistical recursions whose serialized state is checked against ordered evidence. A stronger composition should make immutable evaluation events authoritative, derive candidate-local and cross-candidate statistical state from those events, then connect that substrate to reversible agent versions, provider write-ahead reconciliation, and a terminal OUTER surface.
exact_next_action: Search public real self-improvement implementations for an AgentOpt-like reversible version loop that already binds candidate identity and evaluation events to a PACE/Harn-style anytime-valid CERTIFY path plus restart-durable candidate-crossing statistical spending. Prioritize source paths that derive statistical state from an immutable ordered outcome log, perform provider/evaluator write-ahead reconciliation, and expose a structurally non-iterative terminal OUTER namespace. If no single system exists, inspect the smallest source-level seam for integrating an Active-Inference-Power-style frozen/filtration/online-FDR substrate under an existing reversible agent improver without weakening the terminal outer-evaluation boundary.
